The fcrepo-mint module has been moved to: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-mint

When it is convenient, Andrew Woods can enable travis builds for this module.

  • fcrepo-mint/pom.xml needs an SCM section
  • fcrepo-camel-toolbox is failing to build

fcrepo-camel-toolbox is pegged at fcrepo version 4.4.0, so this change shouldn't affect it. Are you seeing the build failures after changing the spring configuration? I would expect that. The spring config should not be changed until the project is pegged to the next released version of fedora.

PR to address fcrepo-mint maven configuration: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-mint/pull/1

Also, the fcrepo-camel PR should not be included in this. If anything, this PR should supersede it:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel/pull/98 from https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1769
